shortDescription: Adds a new custom DLP engine.

options.name: api_key
options.description: A string that contains the obfuscated API key.

options.name: client_id
options.description: The client ID for OAuth2 authentication.

options.name: client_secret
options.description: The client secret for OAuth2 authentication.

options.name: cloud
options.description: The Zscaler cloud name provisioned for your organization.

options.name: engine_expression
options.description: The logical expression that defines a DLP engine by combining DLP dictionaries using logical operators. Namely All (AND), Any (OR), Exclude (NOT), and Sum (the total number of content matches). ((D63.S > 1)). ((D38.S > 1) AND (D63.S > 1)). ((D38.S > 1) OR (D63.S > 1)). (SUM(D63.S, D38.S) > 3). In the preceding examples, 63 represents the ID of the Credit Cards dictionary ID. 61 is the Financial Statements ID, and 38 is the ABA Bank Routing Numbers dictionary ID. Each dictionary ID is wrapped aro

options.name: id
options.description: The unique identifier for the DLP engine.

options.name: name
options.description: The DLP engine name as configured by the admin. This attribute is required in POST and PUT requests for custom DLP engines.

options.name: password
options.description: A string that contains the password for the API admin.

options.name: private_key
options.description: The private key for JWT-based OAuth2 authentication.

options.name: sandbox_cloud
options.description: The Sandbox cloud environment for API access.

options.name: sandbox_token
options.description: A string that contains the Sandbox API Key.

options.name: state
options.description: Specifies the desired state of the resource.

options.name: use_legacy_client
options.description: Whether to use the legacy Zscaler API client.

options.name: username
options.description: A string that contains the email ID of the API admin.

options.name: vanity_domain
options.description: The vanity domain provisioned by Zscaler for OAuth2 flows.
